title.narrative: Collective sites support, Access provision, Relief and Evacuation.

description.narrative: ltpgtThe escalation of military offensive since summer 2024 has dramatically increased the number of people who are compelled to evacuate to safer regions in the west of Ukraine and at the same time forcing providers of basic lifesaving services and goods retreat further from dangerous areas of active hostilities leaving people who wish to stay in their homes without access some or all of basic goods and services.ltbrgtHumanitarian mission “Proliska” within the project will help both categories of affected population. ltbrgtFor those people who wished to stay in their homes Proliska will provide social transportation to the nearest settlement in the rear where social, medical, commercial and administrative services are available. Transportation routes will go along a number of settlements, collect people transport to services and back to their settlements. Drinking water in bottles will be distributed among passengers.ltbrgtFor people who wish to evacuate the following options will be provided based on their needs:ltbrgt- mass evacuation by busses from designated bus stops to transit shelters, collective sites, railway stations (evacuation trains), etc…ltbrgt- evacuation of immobile, seriously ill and wounded people by dully equipped ambulances accompanied by medical personnel addressing not only health issues but hygiene needs as well, ensuring safe and dignified transportation to any region of Ukraineltbrgt- individual evacuations for small amount of people by smaller vehicles from settlements away from evacuation routes or unreachable by big busses due to security reasons and state of roads.ltbrgtBased on our experience we identified that during evacuation the most need is water and hygiene necessities which we will provide.ltbrgtThe particulars of evacuation in the context of military escalation is that it is transportation of people from highly dangerous locations in close proximity to active hostilities (air raids and shelling) truly saves lives, however we observe that evacuated people as soon as they arrive to new locations face new challenges: no money, poor health condition, no accommodation, no documents and no social orientation. Thus, we plan to ensure meeting of all evacuation routes in regions of Proliska presence (Dnipropetrovska, Kharkivska etc...). While meeting evacuees we will assist with luggage, settlements, distribute transit hygiene kits and will identify the most vulnerable people which will be referred to case managers and psychologists from other projects or organizations. In Zakarpatska oblasts which is a destination for mass evacuation mostly be trains we will ensure comprehensive assistance by the very project: meeting at the railway station, transportation to collective sites and provision of psychological and case management assistance. ltbrgtAs the newly evacuated people's first need is accommodation our aim is to create places for these people in Poltavska, Sumska, Dnipropetrovska, Kharkivska and Zakarpatska oblasts. For this we will identify, repair and equip collective sites according to Cluster standards.ltbrgtProliska will also provide institutional support to relocated government and non-governmental care facilities for the most vulnerable IDPs (people with disabilities, older people). We will ensure the adherence to the requirements of the provision of Cabinet of Ministries of Ukraine and Ministry of Social Policy Standards for these kinds of facilities from the identification and approval of facilities stage to repair works and equipment and future handover to local authorities for social service provision by municipal service provider or by supporting non-government service provider with registration in the MoSP registry. Proliska will identify, repair and equip these facilities in adherence to all standards (barrier-free, accessibility) facilities. ltbrgtThe project will cover 10 oblasts of Ukraine: Chernihivska, Sumska, Poltavska, Kharkivska, Donetska, Dnipropetrovska, Zaporizka, Khersonska, Mykolaivska and Zakarpatska. ltbrgt lt/pgt
